symptom: `describe microflow` prints `-- Empty action` for a `set task outcome` / `open user task` / `notify workflow` statement (default engine); a describe→drop→exec round-trip silently drops it. Legacy engine (`MXCLI_ENGINE=legacy`) describes it fine
cause: The modelsdk read path (`actionFromGen`) had no case for the workflow microflow actions, so they read back as nil → "Empty action". The write path + DESCRIBE formatter already handled them; only the modelsdk read case was missing
insight: Add cases for `genMf.SetTaskOutcomeAction` / `OpenUserTaskAction` / `NotifyWorkflowAction`, mirroring the legacy parsers. Test `TestActionFromGen_WorkflowActions`; repro `mdl-examples/bug-tests/54-describe-set-task-outcome.mdl`. FINDINGS #54
